concerns.text: No task in tasks.md addresses SC‑001 (Pearson correlation measurement). The plan maps SC‑001 to `code/evaluate.py`, but there is no corresponding implementation or test task (e.g., a task like `T0XX [US?] Implement correlation analysis in code/evaluate.py`). This leaves the success criterion untestable.

The plan expects a `code/utils/config.py` module for loading runtime limits, yet tasks.md contains no task to create or validate this file. Without a task (e.g., `T0YY [P] Implement config loader in code/utils/config.py`), the computational feasibility checks (SC‑005) lack a concrete implementation.
